data.one_liner: A day and night time picker widget for Flutter featuring a sun and moon animation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable time picker widget for Flutter that supports both modal dialog and inline presentation. It features a unique day/night visual header with Sun and Moon assets, 12-hour and 24-hour formats, second selection, and an iOS-style wheel picker option.
use_when: You want a visually engaging time picker with day and night animations.
You need an inline or modal time picker supporting 12hr and 24hr formats.
avoid_when: You prefer using the standard platform-native time picker dialog.
You need date picking functionality combined with the time picker.
strengths: Visually attractive day/night animation header with customizable assets.
Extensively customizable properties including intervals, min/max bounds, and styling.
weaknesses: Limited to time selection only, not suitable for full date-time picking.
Day/night visual header might not fit minimalist enterprise design systems.
data.setup_notes: No native setup or permissions required.
